{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Red Group'', form up behind me. We're commencing our ''attack'' on the ''main reactor''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Hotshot (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.54|Hotshot (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Red Group''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], they flew [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] under [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during a [[Battle of the Enoth system|battle]] in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]].
